sentences.zh: 求朔望入交

translations.literal: To find new and full moon entry into convergence.
translations.idiomatic: To find new and full moon entry into convergence.

sentences.zh: （先置裏差，半之，如九而一，所得依其加減天正朔積分，然後求之。）〉

translations.literal: (First set the li difference, halve it, take one-ninth of that value, and add or subtract from the civil new-year new-moon accumulated parts according to the result; only then proceed with the calculation.)
translations.idiomatic: (First set the li difference, halve it, take one-ninth of that value, and add or subtract from the civil new-year new-moon accumulated parts accordingly; only then proceed.)

sentences.zh: 置天正朔積分，以交終分去之，不盡，如日法而一，為日，不滿為余，即得天正十一月中朔入交泛日及余秒。

translations.literal: Set the civil new-year new-moon accumulated parts; remove by convergence termination parts; what does not exhaust, divide by the day divisor for days and the remainder for parts — that is the civil eleventh month central new-moon general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the civil new-year new-moon accumulated parts, discard full convergence termination parts, divide the remainder by the day divisor for days and parts, and obtain the eleventh-month central new-moon general convergence day, remainder, and seconds.

sentences.zh: （便為中朔加時入交泛日及余。）〉

translations.literal: (This is then the central new-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder.)
translations.idiomatic: (This is the central new-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder.)

sentences.zh: 交朔加之，得次朔；

translations.literal: Add the convergence new-moon increment — obtain the next new moon;
translations.idiomatic: Add the convergence new-moon increment to obtain the next new moon;

sentences.zh: 交望加之，得望；

translations.literal: Add the convergence full-moon increment — obtain the full moon;
translations.idiomatic: Add the convergence full-moon increment to obtain the full moon;

sentences.zh: 再加交望，亦得次朔；

translations.literal: Add the convergence full-moon increment again — also obtain the next new moon;
translations.idiomatic: Add the convergence full-moon increment again to obtain the next new moon;

sentences.zh: 各為朔望入交泛日及余秒。

translations.literal: Each yields the new- and full-moon general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Each yields the general convergence day, remainder, and seconds for every new and full moon.

sentences.zh: （凡稱余秒者，微亦從之，余仿此。）〉

translations.literal: (Whenever remainder seconds are named, micro-units follow likewise; for remainders follow this pattern.)
translations.idiomatic: (Whenever remainder seconds are named, micro-units follow likewise; treat other remainders the same way.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求定朔及每日夜半入交】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the fixed new moon and daily midnight entry into convergence】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the fixed new moon and daily midnight entry into convergence〉

sentences.zh: 各置入交泛日及余秒，減去中朔望小余，即為定朔望夜半入交泛日及余秒。

translations.literal: Set each general convergence day and remainder seconds; subtract the central new- or full-moon minor remainder — that is the fixed new or full moon midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set each general convergence day and remainder seconds, subtract the central new- or full-moon minor remainder, and obtain the fixed new or full moon midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 若定朔望有進退者，亦進退交日，否則因中為定，大月加二日，小月加一日，餘皆加四千一百二十，秒六百九十三，微八十，即次朔夜半入交；

translations.literal: If the fixed new or full moon advances or retreats, advance or retreat the convergence day likewise; otherwise follow the central value as fixed. In a long month add two days, in a short month one day; to the remainder always add 4,120, seconds 693, micro 80 — that is the next new moon's midnight convergence entry;
translations.idiomatic: If a fixed new or full moon advances or retreats, adjust the convergence day likewise; otherwise take the central value as fixed. Add two days in a long month and one in a short month; always add 4,120 to the remainder with seconds 693 and micro-units 80 for the next new moon's midnight convergence entry;

sentences.zh: 累加一日，滿交終日及余秒，去之，即每日夜半入交泛日及余秒。

translations.literal: Accumulate one day; when full discard the convergence termination day and remainder seconds — that is each day's midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add one day cumulatively, cast out full convergence termination days and remainder seconds, and obtain each day's midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈【求定朔望加時入交】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find fixed new and full moon hour-of-addition entry into convergence】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find fixed new and full moon hour-of-addition entry into convergence〉

sentences.zh: 置中朔望加時入交泛日及余秒，以入氣入轉朓朒定數朓減朒加之，即得定朔望加時入交泛日及余秒。

translations.literal: Set the central new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder seconds; with the entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers, tiao subtract and chuo add — that is the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the central new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder seconds, apply the entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers (tiao subtract, chuo add), and obtain the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈【求定朔望加時入交積度及陰陽歷】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition convergence accumulated degrees and yang/yin calendar】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition convergence accumulated degrees and yang/yin calendar〉

sentences.zh: 置定朔望加時入交泛日，以日法通之，內余進二位，如三萬九千一百二十一而一，為度，不滿，退除為分秒，即得定朔望加時月行入交積度；

translations.literal: Set the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day; communicate it by the day divisor and include the remainder, advance two places, take 39,121 as one degree, reduce what does not fill to parts and seconds — that is the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition moon's entry into convergence accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed new- or full-moon hour-of-addition general convergence day, convert through the day divisor with the remainder, shift two places, divide by 39,121 for degrees, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain the hour-of-addition moon's entry into convergence accumulated degree;

sentences.zh: 以定朔望加時入轉遲疾度遲減疾加之，即為月行入定交積度；

translations.literal: With the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition entry-into-rotation slow-fast degree, slow subtract and fast add — that is the moon's fixed entry into convergence accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: Apply the fixed syzygy hour's entry-into-rotation slow-fast degree (slow subtract, fast add) to obtain the moon's fixed entry into convergence accumulated degree;

sentences.zh: 如交中度以下，為入陽歷積度，以上，去之，為入陰歷積度。

translations.literal: At or below convergence middle, it is yang-calendar accumulated degree; above, remove it — yin-calendar accumulated degree.
translations.idiomatic: At or below convergence middle counts as yang-calendar accumulated degree; above, subtract it to obtain yin-calendar accumulated degree.

sentences.zh: （每日夜半準此求之。）〉

translations.literal: (Each day at midnight, seek by this procedure.)
translations.idiomatic: (For each midnight, follow this procedure.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求月去黃道度】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the moon's ecliptic latitude (departure from the yellow path)〉

sentences.zh: 視月入陰陽歷積度及分，交象以下，為少象；

translations.literal: Inspect the entered yin- or yang-calendar accumulated degree and parts; at or below the convergence image, it is the young image;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the entered yin- or yang-calendar accumulated degree and parts; at or below the convergence image counts as the young image;

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減交中，余為老象。

translations.literal: above, cover and subtract convergence middle; the remainder is the old image.
translations.idiomatic: above, cover and subtract convergence middle; the remainder is the old image.

sentences.zh: 置所入老少象度於上位，列交象度於下，相減，相乘，倍之，退位為分，分滿百為度，用減所入老少象度及分；

translations.literal: Set the entered young or old image degree above and array the convergence image degree below; subtract and multiply, double and step back one place for parts, when parts fill 100 they become degrees; use that to subtract from the entered young or old image degree and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the entered young or old image degree above and the convergence image degree below, subtract and multiply, double and shift one place for parts, convert hundreds to degrees, and subtract from the entered young or old image degree and parts;

sentences.zh: 余，又與交中度相減、相乘，八因之，以一百一十除之，為分，分滿百為度，即得月去黃道度及分。

translations.literal: with the remainder again subtract and multiply against convergence middle, multiply by eight, divide by 110 for parts, when parts fill 100 they become degrees — that is the moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: then with the remainder subtract and multiply against convergence middle, multiply by eight, divide by 110 for parts, convert hundreds to degrees, and obtain the moon's departure from the yellow path in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 〈【求朔望加時入交常日及定日】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general and fixed convergence days】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find new- and full-moon hour-of-addition general and fixed convergence days〉

sentences.zh: 置朔望入交泛日，以入氣朓朒定數朓減朒加，為入交常日。

translations.literal: Set the new- and full-moon general convergence day; with the entry-into-qi tiao–chuo fixed number, tiao subtract and chuo add — that is the general convergence day.
translations.idiomatic: Set the new- or full-moon general convergence day, apply the entry-into-qi tiao–chuo fixed number (tiao subtract, chuo add), and obtain the general convergence day.

sentences.zh: 又置入轉朓朒定數，進一位，以一百二十七而一，所得，朓減朒加交常日，為入交定日及余秒。

translations.literal: Again set the entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed number, advance one place, divide by 127; with the result tiao subtract and chuo add to the general convergence day — that is the fixed convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed number, shift one place, divide by 127, apply tiao subtract and chuo add to the general convergence day, and obtain the fixed convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈【求入交陰陽歷交前後分】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find entry-into-convergence yang/yin calendar before and after parts】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find entry-into-convergence yang/yin calendar before and after parts〉

sentences.zh: 視入交定日，如交中以下，為陽歷；

translations.literal: Inspect the fixed entry-into-convergence day; at or below convergence middle, it is yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the fixed entry-into-convergence day; at or below convergence middle counts as yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 以上，去之，為陰歷。

translations.literal: above, remove it — yin calendar.
translations.idiomatic: above, subtract it — yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 如一日上下，以日法通日內分，內余為交後分；

translations.literal: If about one day above or below, communicate the day by the day divisor into parts and include the remainder — that is the after-convergence part;
translations.idiomatic: If within about one day, convert the day through the day divisor into parts with the remainder included — that is the after-convergence part;

sentences.zh: 十三日上下，覆減交中日，余為交前分。

translations.literal: If about thirteen days above or below, cover and subtract the convergence mid-cycle day — the remainder is the before-convergence part.
translations.idiomatic: If within about thirteen days, cover and subtract the convergence mid-cycle day to obtain the before-convergence part.

sentences.zh: 〈【求日月食甚定余】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the fixed remainder for solar and lunar eclipse greatest】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the fixed remainder for solar and lunar eclipse greatest〉

sentences.zh: 置朔望入氣入轉朓朒定數，同名相從，異名相消，以一千三百三十七乘之，以定朔望加時入轉算外轉定分除之，所得，以朓減朒加中朔望小余，為泛余。

translations.literal: Set the new- and full-moon entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers; of the same name follow together, of different name cancel; multiply by 1,337; divide by the fixed new- and full-moon hour-of-addition entry-into-rotation count-outside rotation fixed parts; with the result tiao subtract and chuo add to the central new- and full-moon minor remainder — that is the general remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Set the new- and full-moon entry-into-qi and entry-into-rotation tiao–chuo fixed numbers, combine same names and cancel different names, multiply by 1,337, divide by the fixed syzygy hour's entry-into-rotation count-outside rotation fixed parts, apply tiao subtract and chuo add to the central new- and full-moon minor remainder, and obtain the general remainder.

sentences.zh: 日食，視泛余，如半法以下，為中前，半法以上，去之，為中後。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: inspect the general remainder; at or below the half method, it is before middle; at or above the half method, remove it — after middle.
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipse: if the general remainder is at or below the half method, it is before middle; at or above the half method, subtract the half method for after middle.

sentences.zh: 置中前後分，與半法相減、相乘，倍之，萬約為分，曰時差。

translations.literal: Set the before- and after-middle parts; subtract and multiply against the half method, double, reduce by 10,000 for parts — call this time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the before- and after-middle parts, subtract and multiply against the half method, double, and reduce by 10,000 to obtain the time difference.

sentences.zh: 中前以時差減泛余，為定余；

translations.literal: Before middle: subtract the time difference from the general remainder for the fixed remainder;
translations.idiomatic: Before middle: subtract the time difference from the general remainder to obtain the fixed remainder;

sentences.zh: 覆減半法，余為午前分；

translations.literal: cover and subtract the half method — the remainder is the before-noon part;
translations.idiomatic: cover and subtract the half method — the remainder is the before-noon part;

sentences.zh: 中後以時差加泛余，為定余；

translations.literal: After middle: add the time difference to the general remainder for the fixed remainder;
translations.idiomatic: After middle: add the time difference to the general remainder to obtain the fixed remainder;

sentences.zh: 減去半法，余為午後分。

translations.literal: Subtract the half method — the remainder is the after-noon part.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the half method to obtain the after-noon part.

sentences.zh: 月食，視泛余，在日入後夜半前，如日法四分之三以下，減去半法，為酉前分；

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: inspect the general remainder after sunset and before midnight; at or below three-quarters of the day divisor, subtract the half method — that is the before-you part;
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse: if the general remainder falls after sunset and before midnight, at or below three-quarters of the day divisor subtract the half method for the before-you part;

sentences.zh: 四分之三以上，覆減日法，余為酉後分。

translations.literal: At or above three-quarters, cover and subtract the day divisor — the remainder is the after-you part.
translations.idiomatic: Above three-quarters, cover and subtract the day divisor for the after-you part.

sentences.zh: 又視泛余，在夜半後日出前者，如日法四分之一以下，為卯前分；

translations.literal: Again inspect the general remainder after midnight and before sunrise: at or below one-quarter of the day divisor, it is the before-mao part;
translations.idiomatic: If after midnight and before sunrise, at or below one-quarter of the day divisor counts as before-mao;

sentences.zh: 四分之一以上，覆減半法，余為卯後分。

translations.literal: At or above one-quarter, cover and subtract the half method — the remainder is the after-mao part.
translations.idiomatic: Above one-quarter, cover and subtract the half method for the after-mao part.

sentences.zh: 其卯酉前後分，自相乘，四因，退位，萬約為分，以加泛余，為定余。

translations.literal: For the before- and after-mao and before- and after-you parts, self-multiply each, multiply by four, step back one place, reduce by 10,000 for parts, and add to the general remainder — that is the fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Self-multiply each of the before- and after-mao and before- and after-you parts, multiply by four, shift one place back, reduce by 10,000 for parts, add to the general remainder, and obtain the fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 各置定余，以發斂加時法求之，即得日月食甚辰刻及分秒。

translations.literal: Set each fixed remainder and seek with the aggregation-and-release hour-of-addition method — that is the double-hour and ke when sun and moon are at eclipse greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Set each fixed remainder and apply the aggregation-and-release hour-of-addition method to obtain the double-hour and ke of eclipse greatest.

sentences.zh: 〈【求日月食甚日行積度】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find solar and lunar eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the solar motion accumulated degree at eclipse greatest〉

sentences.zh: 置定朔望食甚大小余，與中朔望大小余相減之，余以加減中朔望入氣日余，

translations.literal: Set the fixed new- and full-moon eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders; the remainder of subtracting the central new- and full-moon major and minor remainders is used to add and subtract the central new- and full-moon entry-into-qi day remainder,
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed syzygy eclipse-greatest major and minor remainders, subtract the central syzygy major and minor remainders, and with the difference adjust the central syzygy entry-into-qi day remainder,

sentences.zh: （以中朔望少加多減。）〉

translations.literal: (Central new and full moon: when the day is less, add more and subtract less.)
translations.idiomatic: (When the central syzygy day count is less, add more and subtract less.)

sentences.zh: 即為食甚入氣；

translations.literal: That is entry into qi at eclipse greatest;
translations.idiomatic: That is the entry into qi at eclipse greatest;

sentences.zh: 以加其氣中積，為食甚中積。

translations.literal: Add to its qi mid-accumulation — that is the mid-accumulation at eclipse greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Add that to the qi mid-accumulation to obtain the mid-accumulation at eclipse greatest.

sentences.zh: 又置食甚入氣余，以所入氣日損益率

translations.literal: Again set the entry-into-qi remainder at eclipse greatest; multiply by that qi day's gain-and-loss rate
translations.idiomatic: Set the entry-into-qi remainder at eclipse greatest and multiply by that qi day's gain-and-loss rate

sentences.zh: （盈縮之損益。）〉

translations.literal: (of excess-and-deficit adjustment.)
translations.idiomatic: (the excess-and-deficit gain-and-loss.)

sentences.zh: 乘之，如日法而一，以損益其日盈縮積，盈加縮減食甚中積，即為食甚日行積度及分。

translations.literal: Multiply, divide by the day divisor, and with that add or subtract that day's excess-and-deficit accumulation; excess adds and deficit subtracts from the eclipse-greatest mid-accumulation — that is the eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply, divide by the day divisor, adjust that day's excess-and-deficit accumulation, then excess adds and deficit subtracts from the eclipse-greatest mid-accumulation to obtain the eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 先以食甚中積經分為約分，然後加減之，余類此者，依而求之。

translations.literal: First take the eclipse-greatest mid-accumulation canonical parts as reduced parts, then add and subtract; for remainders of this kind, seek by the same method.
translations.idiomatic: First reduce the eclipse-greatest mid-accumulation canonical parts, then add and subtract; for similar remainders, follow the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 〈【求氣差】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find qi difference】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find qi difference〉

sentences.zh: 置日食食甚日行積度及分，滿中限去之，余在象限以下，為初限；

translations.literal: Set the solar eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts; remove by the central limit; if the remainder is at or below the image limit, it is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar eclipse-greatest daily solar motion accumulated degree and parts, cast out the central limit, and if the remainder is at or below the image limit it is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減中限，為末限；

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract the central limit for the final limit;
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract the central limit for the final limit;

sentences.zh: 皆自相乘，進二位，以四百七十八而一，所得，用減一千七百四十四，余為氣差恒數；

translations.literal: in each case self-multiply, advance two places, divide by 478; with the result subtract from 1,744 — the remainder is the qi-difference constant;
translations.idiomatic: self-multiply in each case, shift two places, divide by 478, subtract from 1,744, and obtain the qi-difference constant;

sentences.zh: 以午前後分乘之，半晝分除之，所得，以減恒數，為定數。

translations.literal: Multiply by the before- or after-noon part and divide by half the day-length part; with the result subtract from the constant — that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the before- or after-noon part, divide by half the day-length part, subtract from the constant, and obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: （如不及減者，覆減為定數，應加者減之，應減者加之。）〉

translations.literal: (If it cannot be subtracted, cover and subtract for the fixed number; where it should add, subtract; where it should subtract, add.)
translations.idiomatic: (If subtraction fails, cover and subtract instead; where addition is indicated, subtract; where subtraction is indicated, add.)

sentences.zh: 春分後，陽歷減陰歷加；

translations.literal: After the spring equinox, yang calendar subtracts and yin calendar adds;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, yang calendar subtracts and yin calendar adds;

sentences.zh: 秋分後，陽歷加陰歷減。

translations.literal: After the autumn equinox, yang calendar adds and yin calendar subtracts.
translations.idiomatic: After the autumn equinox, yang calendar adds and yin calendar subtracts.

sentences.zh: （春分前秋分後，各二日二千一百分為定氣，於此宜加減之。）〉

translations.literal: (Before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, two days and 2,100 parts each are the fixed qi; apply the addition and subtraction within this.)
translations.idiomatic: (Before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, treat two days and 2,100 parts each as fixed qi and apply these additions and subtractions within that interval.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求刻差】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find ke difference】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find ke difference〉

sentences.zh: 置日食食甚日行積度及分，滿中限去之，余與中限相減、相乘，進二位，如四百七十八而一，所得，為刻差恒數；

translations.literal: Set the solar-eclipse-greatest solar daily accumulated degree and parts; when full discard the middle limit; with the remainder multiply the difference from the middle limit, advance two places, divide by 478 — the result is the ke-difference constant;
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar-eclipse-greatest solar daily accumulated degree and parts, discard full middle limits, multiply the remainder by its distance from the middle limit, advance two places, divide by 478, and obtain the ke-difference constant;

sentences.zh: 以午前後分乘之，日法四分之一除，所得，為定數。

translations.literal: Multiply by the before- and after-noon parts; divide by one quarter of the day divisor — the result is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the before- and after-noon parts and divide by one quarter of the day divisor to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: （若在恒數以上者，倍恒數，以所得之數減之，為定數，依其加減。）〉

translations.literal: (If above the constant, double the constant and subtract the obtained number for the fixed number; add or subtract accordingly.)
translations.idiomatic: (If above the constant, double the constant, subtract the obtained number for the fixed number, and apply the indicated additions or subtractions.)

sentences.zh: 冬至後，午前陽加陰減，午後陽減陰加；

translations.literal: After winter solstice, before noon: yang add, yin subtract; after noon: yang subtract, yin add;
translations.idiomatic: After winter solstice, before noon add in the yang case and subtract in the yin case; after noon subtract in the yang case and add in the yin case;

sentences.zh: 夏至後，午前陽減陰加，午後陽加陰減。

translations.literal: After summer solstice, before noon: yang subtract, yin add; after noon: yang add, yin subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice, before noon subtract in the yang case and add in the yin case; after noon add in the yang case and subtract in the yin case.

sentences.zh: 〈【求日食去交前後定分】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the solar eclipse fixed distance from crossing before and after】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the solar eclipse fixed distance from crossing before and after〉

sentences.zh: 置氣刻二差定數，同名相從，異名相消，為食差；

translations.literal: Set the qi and quarter-mark two-difference fixed numbers: same name combine, different name cancel — this is the eclipse difference;
translations.idiomatic: Set the qi- and quarter-mark-difference fixed numbers, combine those of the same name and cancel those of different name, and obtain the eclipse difference;

sentences.zh: 依其加減去交前後分，為去交前後定分。

translations.literal: According to their additions and subtractions remove from the crossing before-and-after parts — these are the fixed crossing before-and-after parts.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the additions and subtractions to the crossing before-and-after parts to obtain the fixed crossing before-and-after parts.

sentences.zh: 視其前後定分，如在陽歷，即不食；

translations.literal: View the before-and-after fixed parts: if in the yang calendar, then no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the before-and-after fixed parts: in the yang calendar there is no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 如在陰歷，即有食之。

translations.literal: if in the yin calendar, then there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: in the yin calendar there is an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 如交前陰歷不及減，反減之，

translations.literal: If before crossing in the yin calendar it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction,
translations.idiomatic: If before crossing in the yin calendar subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction,

sentences.zh: （反減食差。）〉

translations.literal: (reverse-subtract the eclipse difference.)
translations.idiomatic: (reverse-subtract the eclipse difference.)

sentences.zh: 為交後陽歷；

translations.literal: that becomes after-crossing yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: that becomes after-crossing yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 交後陰歷不及減，反減之，為交前陽歷；

translations.literal: if after crossing in the yin calendar it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction — that is before-crossing yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: if after crossing in the yin calendar subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction to obtain before-crossing yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 即不食。

translations.literal: then no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: then there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交前陽歷不及減，反減之，為交後陰歷；

translations.literal: if before crossing in the yang calendar it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction — that is after-crossing yin calendar;
translations.idiomatic: if before crossing in the yang calendar subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction to obtain after-crossing yin calendar;

sentences.zh: 交後陽歷不及減，反減之，為交前陰歷；

translations.literal: if after crossing in the yang calendar it is insufficient to subtract, reverse the subtraction — that is before-crossing yin calendar;
translations.idiomatic: if after crossing in the yang calendar subtraction is insufficient, reverse the subtraction to obtain before-crossing yin calendar;

sentences.zh: 即日有食之。

translations.literal: then that day there is a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: then that day there is a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 〈【求日食分】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the solar eclipse parts】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the solar eclipse parts〉

sentences.zh: 視去交前後定分，如二千四百以下，為既前分；

translations.literal: View the fixed crossing before-and-after parts: if 2,400 or below, these are before-totality parts;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the fixed crossing before-and-after parts: at 2,400 or below take before-totality parts;

sentences.zh: 以二百四十八除，為大分；

translations.literal: divide by 248 for great parts;
translations.idiomatic: divide by 248 for great parts;

sentences.zh: 二千四百以上，覆減五千五百，

translations.literal: If 2,400 or above, cover and subtract 5,500,
translations.idiomatic: If 2,400 or above, cover and subtract 5,500,

sentences.zh: （不足減者不食。）〉

translations.literal: (if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.)
translations.idiomatic: (if subtraction is insufficient, there is no eclipse.)

sentences.zh: 為既後分；

translations.literal: these are after-totality parts;
translations.idiomatic: these are after-totality parts;

sentences.zh: 以三百二十除，為大分，不盡，退除為秒。

translations.literal: divide by 320 for great parts; what does not exhaust, retreat and divide for seconds.
translations.idiomatic: divide by 320 for great parts and convert any remainder into seconds.

sentences.zh: （其一分以下者，涉交太淺，太陽光盛，或不見食。）〉

translations.literal: (For one part or below, the crossing is too shallow, the sun's light is strong, and the eclipse may not be visible.)
translations.idiomatic: (At one part or below the crossing is too shallow, the sun's light too strong, and the eclipse may not be visible.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求月食分】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the lunar eclipse parts】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the lunar eclipse parts〉

sentences.zh: 視去交前後分，

translations.literal: View the crossing before-and-after parts,
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the crossing before-and-after parts,

sentences.zh: （不用氣刻差者。）〉

translations.literal: (do not use the qi and quarter-mark differences.)
translations.idiomatic: (without using the qi and quarter-mark differences.)

sentences.zh: 一千七百以下者，食既；

translations.literal: if 1,700 or below, the eclipse is total;
translations.idiomatic: at 1,700 or below the eclipse is total;

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減五千一百，

translations.literal: if above, cover and subtract 5,100,
translations.idiomatic: if above, cover and subtract 5,100,

sentences.zh: （不足減者不食。）〉

translations.literal: (if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.)
translations.idiomatic: (if subtraction is insufficient, there is no eclipse.)

sentences.zh: 余以三百四十除之，為大分；

translations.literal: With the remainder divide by 340 for great parts;
translations.idiomatic: Divide the remainder by 340 for great parts;

sentences.zh: 不盡，退除為秒，即月食之分秒。

translations.literal: what does not exhaust, retreat and divide for seconds — these are the lunar eclipse parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Convert any remainder into seconds to obtain the lunar eclipse parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 去交分在既限以下，覆減既限，亦以三百四十除之，為既內之大分。

translations.literal: If the distance-from-crossing parts are at or below the totality limit, cover and subtract the totality limit and likewise divide by 340 — these are the great parts within totality.
translations.idiomatic: If the distance-from-crossing parts are at or below the totality limit, cover and subtract the totality limit and likewise divide by 340 for the great parts within totality.

sentences.zh: 〈【求日食定用分】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the solar eclipse fixed usage parts】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the solar eclipse fixed usage parts〉

sentences.zh: 置日食之大分，與二十分相減、相乘，又以二千四百五十乘之，如定朔入轉算外轉定分而一，所得，為定用分；

translations.literal: Set the solar eclipse great parts; subtract and multiply with 20 parts; multiply again by 2,450; divide by the fixed new moon's entry-into-rotation outside rotation fixed parts — the result is the fixed usage parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the solar eclipse great parts, subtract and multiply with 20 parts, multiply by 2,450, divide by the fixed new moon's outside-rotation fixed parts, and obtain the fixed usage parts;

sentences.zh: 減定余，為初虧分；

translations.literal: Subtract from the fixed remainder — these are the first-diminishment parts;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the fixed remainder to obtain the first-diminishment parts;

sentences.zh: 加定余，為復圓分；

translations.literal: Add to the fixed remainder — these are the restoration-of-roundness parts;
translations.idiomatic: Add to the fixed remainder to obtain the restoration-of-roundness parts;

sentences.zh: 各以發斂加時法求之，即得日食三限辰刻也。

translations.literal: For each, use the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to find them — that yields the solar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to each to obtain the solar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.

sentences.zh: 〈【求月食定用分】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the lunar eclipse fixed usage parts】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the lunar eclipse fixed usage parts〉

sentences.zh: 置月食之大分，與三十五分相減、相乘，又以二千一百乘之，如定望入轉算外轉定分而一，所得，為定用分；

translations.literal: Set the lunar eclipse great parts; subtract and multiply with 35 parts; multiply again by 2,100; divide by the fixed full moon's entry-into-rotation outside rotation fixed parts — the result is the fixed usage parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the lunar eclipse great parts, subtract and multiply with 35 parts, multiply by 2,100, divide by the fixed full moon's outside-rotation fixed parts, and obtain the fixed usage parts;

sentences.zh: 加減定余，為初虧復圓分。

translations.literal: Add and subtract the fixed remainder — these are the first-diminishment and restoration-of-roundness parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add and subtract the fixed remainder to obtain the first-diminishment and restoration-of-roundness parts.

sentences.zh: 各如發斂加時法求之，即得月食三限辰刻。

translations.literal: For each as the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to find them — that yields the lunar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to each to obtain the lunar eclipse's three-limit chen and ke.

sentences.zh: 月食既者，以既內大分，以一十五分相減相乘，又以四千二百乘之，如定望入轉算外轉定分而一，所得為既內分；

translations.literal: When the lunar eclipse is total, take the within-totality great parts, subtract and multiply with 15 parts, multiply again by 4,200, divide by the fixed full moon's entry-into-rotation outside rotation fixed parts — the result is the within-totality parts;
translations.idiomatic: For a total lunar eclipse, take the within-totality great parts, subtract and multiply with 15 parts, multiply by 4,200, divide by the fixed full moon's outside-rotation fixed parts, and obtain the within-totality parts;

sentences.zh: 用減定用分，為既外分。

translations.literal: Subtract these from the fixed usage parts — these are the outside-totality parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract these from the fixed usage parts to obtain the outside-totality parts.

sentences.zh: 置月食定余，減定用分，為初虧分；

translations.literal: Set the lunar eclipse fixed remainder and subtract the fixed usage parts — these are the first-diminishment parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the lunar eclipse fixed remainder, subtract the fixed usage parts, and obtain the first-diminishment parts;

sentences.zh: 因加既外分，為食既分；

translations.literal: Then add the outside-totality parts — these are the eclipse-totality parts;
translations.idiomatic: Then add the outside-totality parts to obtain the eclipse-totality parts;

sentences.zh: 又加既內分，為食甚分；

translations.literal: Again add the within-totality parts — these are the greatest-eclipse parts;
translations.idiomatic: Again add the within-totality parts to obtain the greatest-eclipse parts;

sentences.zh: （即定余分是也。）〉

translations.literal: (that is the fixed remainder parts.)
translations.idiomatic: (This is the fixed remainder parts.)

sentences.zh: 再加既內分，為生光分；

translations.literal: Again add the within-totality parts — these are the light-generation parts;
translations.idiomatic: Again add the within-totality parts to obtain the light-generation parts;

sentences.zh: 復加既外分，為復圓分。

translations.literal: Again add the outside-totality parts — these are the restoration-of-roundness parts.
translations.idiomatic: Again add the outside-totality parts to obtain the restoration-of-roundness parts.

sentences.zh: 各以發斂加時法求之，即得月食五限辰刻及分。

translations.literal: For each use the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to find them — that yields the lunar eclipse's five-limit chen, ke, and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion-contraction hour-addition method to each to obtain the lunar eclipse's five-limit chen, ke, and parts.

sentences.zh: （如月食既者，以十分並既內大分，如其法而求其定用分也。）〉

translations.literal: (For total lunar eclipse, add ten parts together with the within-totality great parts, and by that method seek the fixed usage parts.)
translations.idiomatic: (For a total lunar eclipse, add ten parts to the within-totality great parts and by that method obtain the fixed usage parts.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求月食所入更點】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the lunar eclipse's entry into watch and point】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the lunar eclipse's entry into watch and point〉

sentences.zh: 置食甚所入日晨分，倍之，五約之，為更法；

translations.literal: Set the day's dawn parts at greatest eclipse, double them, and five-reduce to make the watch method;
translations.idiomatic: Set the day's dawn parts at greatest eclipse, double them, and five-reduce to obtain the watch method;

sentences.zh: 又五約之，為點法。

translations.literal: Again five-reduce to make the point method.
translations.idiomatic: Again five-reduce to obtain the point method.

sentences.zh: 乃置月食初末諸分，昏分以上者，減昏分；

translations.literal: Then set the lunar eclipse's beginning-and-end various parts: above dusk parts subtract dusk parts;
translations.idiomatic: Then set the lunar eclipse's beginning-and-end parts: above dusk parts subtract dusk parts;

sentences.zh: 晨分以下者，加晨分；

translations.literal: below dawn parts add dawn parts;
translations.idiomatic: below dawn parts add dawn parts;

sentences.zh: 如不滿更法，為初更；

translations.literal: if insufficient for the watch method, that is the first watch;
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient for the watch method, that is the first watch;

sentences.zh: 不滿點法，為一點。

translations.literal: What does not fill the point divisor is one point.
translations.idiomatic: Any remainder short of the point divisor counts as one point.

sentences.zh: 依法以次求之，即得更點之數。

translations.literal: By the method seek each in sequence — that yields the watch and point numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the method in order to each limit to obtain the watch and point counts.

sentences.zh: 〈【求日食所起】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find where the solar eclipse begins】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Procedure to find the solar eclipse's direction of first contact〉

sentences.zh: 食在既前，初起西南，甚於正南，復於東南。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is before totality: first contact in the southwest, maximum due south, recovery in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Before totality, first contact lies southwest, maximum due south, and recovery southeast.

sentences.zh: 食在既後，初起西北，甚於正北，復於東北。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is after totality: first contact in the northwest, maximum due north, recovery in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: After totality, first contact lies northwest, maximum due north, and recovery northeast.

sentences.zh: 其食八分以上者，皆起正西，復正東。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due west and recover due east.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due west and recovery due east.

sentences.zh: （此據正午地而論之。）〉

translations.literal: (This is discussed with reference to a location at the meridian (noon).)
translations.idiomatic: (This assumes an observer on the local meridian (at noon).)

sentences.zh: 〈【求月食所起】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find where the lunar eclipse begins】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Procedure to find the lunar eclipse's direction of first contact〉

sentences.zh: 月在陽歷，初起東北，甚於正北，復於西北。

translations.literal: When the moon is in the yang calendar: first contact in the northeast, maximum due north, recovery in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: With the moon in the yang calendar, first contact is northeast, maximum due north, and recovery northwest.

sentences.zh: 月在陰歷，初起東南，甚於正南，復於西南。

translations.literal: When the moon is in the yin calendar: first contact in the southeast, maximum due south, recovery in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: With the moon in the yin calendar, first contact is southeast, maximum due south, and recovery southwest.

sentences.zh: 其食八分以上，皆起正東，復正西。

translations.literal: When the eclipse is eight-tenths or more, all begin due east and recover due west.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses of eight-tenths or greater, first contact is always due east and recovery due west.

sentences.zh: （此亦據正午地而論之。）〉

translations.literal: (This too is discussed with reference to a location at the meridian (noon).)
translations.idiomatic: (This likewise assumes an observer on the local meridian (at noon).)

sentences.zh: 求日月出入帶食所見分數

translations.literal: To find the fraction of sun or moon eclipse visible at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the fraction of a solar or lunar eclipse visible when caught at sunrise or sunset

sentences.zh: 各以食甚小余，與日出入分相減，余為帶食差；

translations.literal: For each, set the eclipse-maximum minor remainder and subtract the sun's rise-or-set parts; the remainder is the horizon-partial-eclipse difference;
translations.idiomatic: For each case, subtract the sun's rise-or-set parts from the eclipse-maximum minor remainder to obtain the horizon-partial difference;

sentences.zh: 以乘所食之分，滿定用分而一，

translations.literal: multiply by the fraction eclipsed and divide by the fixed usage parts for one,
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the eclipsed fraction and divide by the fixed usage parts;

sentences.zh: （月食既者，以既內分減帶食差，余乘所食分，如既外分而一，不及減者，為帶食既出入。）〉

translations.literal: (For total lunar eclipse, subtract the within-totality parts from the horizon-partial-eclipse difference; with the remainder multiply the fraction eclipsed and divide by the outside-totality parts for one; if insufficient to subtract, it is partial totality at rise or set.)
translations.idiomatic: (For a total lunar eclipse, subtract the within-totality parts from the horizon-partial difference, multiply the remainder by the eclipsed fraction and divide by the outside-totality parts; if subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is partially total at rise or set.)

sentences.zh: 以減所食分，即日月出入帶食所見之分。

translations.literal: Subtract that from the eclipsed fraction — that is the fraction of sun or moon visible at rise or set with horizon partial eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the result from the eclipsed fraction to obtain the visible fraction at rise or set for sun or moon with horizon partial eclipse.

sentences.zh: （其食甚在晝，晨為漸進，昏為已退；

translations.literal: (When eclipse maximum falls in daytime, dawn means still advancing and dusk means already retreating;
translations.idiomatic: (If greatest eclipse is in daylight, at dawn the eclipse is still advancing and at dusk it has already retreated;

sentences.zh: 食甚在夜，晨為已退，昏為漸進也。）〉

translations.literal: (when eclipse maximum falls at night, dawn means already retreating and dusk means still advancing.)
translations.idiomatic: (if greatest eclipse is at night, at dawn it has already retreated and at dusk it is still advancing.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求日月食甚宿次】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the lodge position at sun or moon eclipse maximum】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Procedure to find the lodge at solar or lunar eclipse maximum〉

sentences.zh: 置日月食甚日行積度，

translations.literal: Set the sun or moon eclipse-maximum daily-motion accumulated degrees,
translations.idiomatic: Set the daily-motion accumulated degrees at eclipse maximum for sun or moon,

sentences.zh: （望即更加望度。）〉

translations.literal: (at full moon add the full-moon degree.)
translations.idiomatic: (at full moon add the full-moon degree.)

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，依黃道宿次去之，即各得日月食甚宿度及分秒。
