sentences.zh: 〈【求五星天正冬至後平合及諸段中積中星】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction after heavenly-origin winter solstice and the central accumulation and central star of each segment】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction after heavenly-origin winter solstice and the central accumulation and central star for every segment〉

sentences.zh: 置通積分，

translations.literal: Set the comprehensive accumulated parts,
translations.idiomatic: Set the comprehensive accumulated parts,

sentences.zh: （先以裏差加減之。）〉

translations.literal: (First add or subtract the inner difference.)
translations.idiomatic: (First apply the inner difference.)

sentences.zh: 各以其星周率去之，不盡，為前合分；

translations.literal: For each, discard by that star's cycle rate; what does not exhaust is the anterior conjunction parts;
translations.idiomatic: For each star, cast out full cycle rates; the remainder is the anterior conjunction parts;

sentences.zh: 覆減周率，余為後合分；

translations.literal: Subtract the cycle rate again; the remainder is the posterior conjunction parts;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the cycle rate again; the remainder is the posterior conjunction parts;

sentences.zh: 如日法而一，不滿，退除為分秒，即得其星天正冬至後平合中積中星。

translations.literal: Divide by the day divisor; what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds—that is that star's mean-conjunction central accumulation and central star after heavenly-origin winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the day divisor, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain that star's mean-conjunction central accumulation and central star after heavenly-origin winter solstice.

sentences.zh: （命為日，曰中積；

translations.literal: (Name as days—called central accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: (Name the result as days—this is the central accumulation;

sentences.zh: 命為度，曰中星。）〉

translations.literal: (Name as degrees—called central star.)
translations.idiomatic: (Name the result as degrees—this is the central star.)

sentences.zh: 以段日累加中積，即為諸段中積；

translations.literal: Accumulate segment days to the central accumulation to obtain each segment's central accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Add segment days cumulatively to the central accumulation to obtain each segment's central accumulation;

sentences.zh: 以平度累加中星，經退則減之，即為諸段中星。

translations.literal: Accumulate mean degrees to the central star, casting back when full, to obtain each segment's central star.
translations.idiomatic: Add mean degrees cumulatively to the central star, casting back when full, to obtain each segment's central star.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星平合及諸段入歷】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's entry into the circuit cycle】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's entry into the circuit cycle〉

sentences.zh: 置通積分，各加其星後合分，以曆率去之，不盡，各以其歷度法除為度，不滿，退除為分秒，即為其星平合入歷度及分秒；

translations.literal: Set the comprehensive accumulated parts; for each, add that star's posterior conjunction parts, discard by the calendar rate, and with what does not exhaust divide by that star's circuit degree divisor for degrees; what does not fill, reduce back for parts and seconds—that is the star's mean-conjunction entry-into-circuit degree and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Set the comprehensive accumulated parts, add each star's posterior conjunction parts, cast out full calendar rates, divide the remainder by that star's circuit degree divisor for degrees, reduce the remainder to parts and seconds, and obtain the mean-conjunction entry-into-circuit degree and parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 以諸段限度累加之，即得諸段入歷度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add each segment's limit degree cumulatively to obtain each segment's entry-into-circuit degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add each segment's limit degree cumulatively to obtain every segment's entry-into-circuit degree and parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星平合及諸段盈縮定差】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference〉

sentences.zh: 各置其星段入歷度及分秒，如在歷中以下，為盈；

translations.literal: For each, set that star and segment's entry-into-circuit degree and parts and seconds; if at or below the circuit mid, it is in excess;
translations.idiomatic: Set each star and segment's entry-into-circuit degree and parts and seconds; at or below the circuit mid counts as excess;

sentences.zh: 以上，減去歷中，余為縮。

translations.literal: if above, subtract the circuit mid; the remainder is in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the circuit mid; the remainder is in deficit.

sentences.zh: 以其星曆策除之，為策數；

translations.literal: Divide by that star's calendar stride for the stride count;
translations.idiomatic: Divide by that star's calendar stride to obtain the stride count;

sentences.zh: 不盡，為入策度及分。

translations.literal: what does not exhaust is the entry-into-stride degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder is the entry-into-stride degree and parts.

sentences.zh: 命策數算外，以其策損益率乘之，余歷策而一，為分，以損益其下盈縮積度，即為其星段盈縮定差。

translations.literal: Name from outside the stride count, multiply the loss-and-gain rate below that stride count, divide the remainder by the circuit stride for parts, and apply it to the excess-and-deficit accumulated degree below—that is that star and segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Name from outside the stride count, multiply the tabulated loss-and-gain rate, divide the remainder by the circuit stride for parts, apply it to the underlying excess-and-deficit accumulation, and obtain that star and segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星平合及諸段定積】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's fixed accumulation】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's fixed accumulation〉

sentences.zh: 各置其星段中積，以其段盈縮定差盈加縮減之，即得其段定積日及分；

translations.literal: For each, set that star and segment's central accumulation; add when in excess and subtract when in deficit by the segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference—that yields the segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set each star and segment's central accumulation and add or subtract the segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference according to excess or deficit to obtain the segment's fixed-accumulation days and parts;

sentences.zh: 加天正冬至大余及約分，滿紀法，去之，不滿，命壬戌算外，即得日辰也。

translations.literal: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts; when full, cast out the era rule; what does not exhaust, name from renxu outside the count—that yields the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts, cast out full era rules, name from renxu outside the count, and obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星平合及諸段所在月日】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's month and day】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's month and day〉

sentences.zh: 各置其段定積，以加天正閏日及約分，以朔策及約分除之，為月數；

translations.literal: For each, set that segment's fixed accumulation, add the heavenly-origin intercalary days and approximate parts, and when full divide by the new-moon policy and approximate parts for month count;
translations.idiomatic: Set each segment's fixed accumulation, add heavenly-origin intercalary days and approximate parts, and divide by the new-moon policy and approximate parts for month count;

sentences.zh: 不盡，為入月以來日數及分。

translations.literal: what does not exhaust is the days and parts elapsed within the month.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder is the days and parts elapsed within the month.

sentences.zh: 其月數，命天正十一月算外，即得其段入月中朔日數及分；

translations.literal: Name the month count from outside the count of heavenly-origin month eleven; that yields the segment's days and parts since the month's mean new moon;
translations.idiomatic: Name the month count from heavenly-origin month eleven outside the count to obtain the segment's days and parts since mean new moon;

sentences.zh: 乃以日辰相距，為所在定朔月日。

translations.literal: the interval of day and double-hour gives the fixed new-moon month and day where it falls.
translations.idiomatic: take the day-and-double-hour interval as the fixed new-moon month and day.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星平合及諸段加時定星】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction and each segment's hour-of-addition fixed star】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction and every segment's hour-of-addition fixed star〉

sentences.zh: 各置中星，以盈縮定差盈加縮減，

translations.literal: For each, set the central star; when in excess add and when in deficit subtract the excess-and-deficit fixed difference,
translations.idiomatic: Set each central star and apply the excess-and-deficit fixed difference (add in excess, subtract in deficit),

sentences.zh: （金星倍之，水星三之，然後加減。）〉

translations.literal: (Double for Venus, triple for Mercury—then add or subtract.)
translations.idiomatic: (Double for Venus and triple for Mercury, then add or subtract.)

sentences.zh: 即為五星諸段定星；

translations.literal: That is the five planets' fixed star for each segment;
translations.idiomatic: The result is each planet's fixed star for every segment;

sentences.zh: 以加天正冬至加時黃道日度，依宿次命之，即其星其段加時所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree and name the lodge by sequence—that is that star and segment's lodge degree and parts and seconds at hour of addition.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the heavenly-origin winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour of addition, name the lodge accordingly, and obtain that star and segment's lodge degree and parts and seconds at hour of addition.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星諸段初日晨前夜半定星】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' fixed star at dawn before midnight on the first day of each segment】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's fixed star at dawn before midnight on the first day of each segment〉

sentences.zh: 各以其段初行率，乘其段定積日下加時分，百約之，乃順減退加其日加時定星，即其段初日晨前夜半定星所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: For each, multiply that segment's initial motion rate by the parts below the hour of addition on the segment's fixed-accumulation day, reduce by 100, then in forward motion subtract and in retrograde add to that day's hour-of-addition fixed star—that is the lodge degree and parts and seconds where the segment-first-day dawn-before-midnight fixed star stands.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply each segment's initial motion rate by the hour-of-addition parts under the segment's fixed-accumulation day, reduce by 100, subtract in forward motion and add in retrograde to that day's hour-of-addition fixed star, and obtain the lodge degree and parts and seconds of the segment-first-day dawn-before-midnight fixed star.

sentences.zh: 〈【求諸段日率度率】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find each segment's day rate and degree rate】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each segment's day rate and degree rate〉

sentences.zh: 各以其段日辰，距後段日辰為日率。

translations.literal: Each takes this segment's day-and-double-hour distance to the next segment's day-and-double-hour as the day rate.
translations.idiomatic: Take each segment's day-and-double-hour interval to the next segment as the day rate.

sentences.zh: 以其段夜半宿次，與後段夜半宿次相減，余為度率。

translations.literal: Subtract this segment's midnight lodge sequence from the next segment's midnight lodge sequence; the remainder is the degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this segment's midnight lodge sequence from the next segment's; the remainder is the degree rate.

sentences.zh: 〈【求諸段平行分】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find each segment's parallel motion parts】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each segment's parallel motion parts〉

sentences.zh: 各置其段度率及分秒，以其段日率除之，即得其段平行度日及分秒。

translations.literal: Set each segment's degree rate and parts and seconds; divide by that segment's day rate—that is that segment's parallel motion degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set each segment's degree rate and parts and seconds, divide by that segment's day rate, and obtain its parallel motion degree and parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈【求諸段總差及日差】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find each segment's total difference and daily difference】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each segment's total difference and daily difference〉

sentences.zh: 本段前後平行分相減，為其段泛差；

translations.literal: Subtract this segment's prior and subsequent parallel motion parts; the remainder is this segment's general difference;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this segment's prior and subsequent parallel motion parts; the remainder is its general difference;

sentences.zh: （假令求木星次疾泛差，乃以順疾順遲平行分相減，余為次疾泛差，他皆仿此。）〉

translations.literal: (Suppose one seeks Jupiter's second-fast general difference: subtract the forward-swift and forward-slow parallel motion parts; the remainder is the second-fast general difference; all other cases follow this pattern.)
translations.idiomatic: (To find Jupiter's second-fast general difference, subtract forward-swift from forward-slow parallel motion parts; the remainder is the second-fast general difference; all other cases follow this pattern.)

sentences.zh: 倍而退位，為增減差；

translations.literal: Double and shift back one place for the increase-decrease difference;
translations.idiomatic: Double the general difference and shift back one place for the increase-decrease difference;

sentences.zh: 加減其段平行分，為初末日行分；

translations.literal: Add or subtract to this segment's parallel motion parts for initial and final day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract it from parallel motion parts to obtain initial and final day motion parts;

sentences.zh: （前多後少者，加為初，減為末；

translations.literal: (If prior is more and subsequent less, add for initial and subtract for final;
translations.idiomatic: (If the prior exceeds the subsequent, add for the initial day and subtract for the final day;

sentences.zh: 前少後多者，減為初，加為末。）〉

translations.literal: (If prior is less and subsequent more, subtract for initial and add for final.)
translations.idiomatic: (If the prior is less and the subsequent more, subtract for the initial day and add for the final day.)

sentences.zh: 倍增減差，為總差；

translations.literal: Double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference;
translations.idiomatic: Double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference;

sentences.zh: 以日率減一除之，為日差。

translations.literal: Divide by the day rate minus one for the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the day rate minus one to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 〈【求前後伏遲退段增減差】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the increase-decrease differences for prior and subsequent concealment, slow, and retrograde segments】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the increase-decrease differences for prior and subsequent concealment, slow, and retrograde segments〉

sentences.zh: 前伏者，置後段初日行分，加其日差之半，為末日行分；

translations.literal: For prior concealment: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, for final-day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For prior concealment, set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, and obtain final-day motion parts;

sentences.zh: 後伏者，置前段末日行分，加其日差之半，為初日行分；

translations.literal: For subsequent concealment: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, for initial-day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For subsequent concealment, set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, add half its daily difference, and obtain initial-day motion parts;

sentences.zh: 以減伏段平行分，余為增減差。

translations.literal: Subtract from the concealment segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the concealment segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 前遲者，置前段末日行分，倍其日差減之，為初日行分；

translations.literal: For prior slow: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, for initial-day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For prior slow motion, set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, and obtain initial-day motion parts;

sentences.zh: 後遲者，置後段初日行分，倍其日差減之，為末日行分；

translations.literal: For subsequent slow: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, for final-day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For subsequent slow motion, set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract double its daily difference, and obtain final-day motion parts;

sentences.zh: 以遲段平行分減之，余為增減差。

translations.literal: Subtract from the slow segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the slow segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: （前後近留遲段。）〉

translations.literal: (Slow segments before and after that lie near station.)
translations.idiomatic: (Slow segments before and after that lie near station.)

sentences.zh: 木火土三星，退行者，六因平行分，退一位，為增減差。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in retrograde: multiply parallel motion parts by six, shift back one place, for the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in retrograde, multiply parallel motion parts by six, shift back one place, and obtain the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 金星，前後伏退者，三因平行分，半而退位，為增減差。

translations.literal: For Venus at prior and subsequent concealment and retrograde: multiply parallel motion parts by three, halve and shift back one place, for the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at prior and subsequent concealment and retrograde, multiply parallel motion parts by three, halve and shift back one place, and obtain the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 前退者，置後段初日之行分，以其日差減之，為末日行分。

translations.literal: For prior retrograde: set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, for final-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For prior retrograde, set the next segment's initial-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, and obtain final-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 後退者，置前段末日之行分，以其日差減之，為初日行分；

translations.literal: For subsequent retrograde: set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, for initial-day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: For subsequent retrograde, set the prior segment's final-day motion parts, subtract its daily difference, and obtain initial-day motion parts;

sentences.zh: 以本段平行分減之，余為增減差。

translations.literal: Subtract from this segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from this segment's parallel motion parts; the remainder is the increase-decrease difference.

sentences.zh: 水星，平行分為增減差，皆以增減差加減平行分，為初末日行分。

translations.literal: For Mercury, take the parallel motion parts as the increase-decrease difference; in each case add or subtract the increase-decrease difference to parallel motion parts for initial and final day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury, take the parallel motion parts as the increase-decrease difference, then add or subtract it from parallel motion parts to obtain initial and final day motion parts.

sentences.zh: （前多後少，加初減末；

translations.literal: (If prior more and subsequent less: add for initial, subtract for final;
translations.idiomatic: (If the prior exceeds the subsequent, add for the initial day and subtract for the final day;

sentences.zh: 前少後多，減初加末。）〉

translations.literal: (If prior less and subsequent more: subtract for initial, add for final.)
translations.idiomatic: (if the prior is less and the subsequent more, subtract for the initial day and add for the final day.)

sentences.zh: 又倍增減差為總差，以日率減一，除之，為日差。

translations.literal: Again double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference; divide by the day rate minus one, for the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Again double the increase-decrease difference for the total difference and divide by the day rate minus one to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 〈【求每日晨前夜半星行宿次】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight〉

sentences.zh: 各置其段初日行分，以日差累損益之，

translations.literal: Set each segment's initial-day motion parts and accumulate additions and subtractions by the daily difference,
translations.idiomatic: Set each segment's initial-day motion parts and apply the daily difference cumulatively,

sentences.zh: （後少則損之，後多則益之。）〉

translations.literal: (If subsequent is less, subtract; if more, add.)
translations.idiomatic: (Subtract when the subsequent value is less and add when it is more.)

sentences.zh: 為每日行度及分秒；

translations.literal: This yields each day's motion degree and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: The result is each day's motion in degrees, parts, and seconds;

sentences.zh: 乃順加退減之，滿宿次去之，即得每日晨前夜半星行宿次。

translations.literal: Then in forward motion add and in retrograde subtract, casting out full lodge sequences, and obtain each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Then add in forward motion and subtract in retrograde, cast out full lodge sequences, and obtain each day's star lodge sequence at dawn before midnight.

sentences.zh: （視前段末日後段初日行分相較之數，不過一二日差為妙；

translations.literal: (Compare the prior segment's final day and next segment's initial day motion parts; a discrepancy of no more than one or two daily differences is best;
translations.idiomatic: (Compare the prior segment's final-day and next segment's initial-day motion parts; a gap of no more than one or two daily differences is ideal;

sentences.zh: 或多日差數倍，或顛倒不倫，當類同前後增減差稍損益之，使其有倫，然後用之。

translations.literal: If the daily difference is several times too large or the sequence is inverted and disorderly, compare with prior and subsequent increase-decrease differences and adjust slightly until orderly, then use it.
translations.idiomatic: If the daily difference is many times too large or the sequence is inverted and incoherent, reconcile it with the surrounding increase-decrease differences, adjust slightly until coherent, and then apply it.

sentences.zh: 或前後平行分俱多俱少，則平註之；

translations.literal: Or if prior and subsequent parallel motion parts are both too large or both too small, level them by equal distribution;
translations.idiomatic: If prior and subsequent parallel motion parts are both too large or both too small, distribute the correction evenly;

sentences.zh: 或總差之秒不盈一分，亦平註之；

translations.literal: Or if the total difference's seconds do not fill one part, also level by equal distribution;
translations.idiomatic: If the total difference's seconds do not reach one part, distribute evenly as well;

sentences.zh: 若有不倫而平註得倫者，亦平註之。）〉

translations.literal: (If disorderly but leveling yields order, level it.)
translations.idiomatic: (If the values are incoherent but even distribution restores coherence, distribute evenly.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星平合及見伏入氣】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction and appearance and concealment entry into qi】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction and appearance-and-concealment entry into qi〉

sentences.zh: 置定積，以氣策及約分除之，為氣數；

translations.literal: Set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi stride and approximate parts for qi count;
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi stride and approximate parts for the qi count,

sentences.zh: 不滿，為入氣日及分秒；

translations.literal: What does not fill is days and parts and seconds entered into qi;
translations.idiomatic: take the remainder as days, parts, and seconds entered into qi;

sentences.zh: 命天正冬至算外，即得所求平合及見伏入氣日及分秒。

translations.literal: Name from heavenly-origin winter solstice outside the count — that is the sought mean conjunction and appearance-and-concealment entry-into-qi days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: name from heavenly-origin winter solstice outside the count, and obtain the mean conjunction and appearance-and-concealment entry-into-qi days, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星平合及見伏行差】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' mean conjunction and appearance and concealment motion difference】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's mean conjunction and appearance-and-concealment motion difference〉

sentences.zh: 各以其段初日星行分與太陽行分相減，余為行差。

translations.literal: Each takes this segment's initial-day star motion parts and subtracts the sun's motion parts; the remainder is the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the sun's motion parts from each segment's initial-day star motion parts; the remainder is the motion difference.

sentences.zh: 若金在退行、水在退合者，相並為行差。

translations.literal: If Venus is in retrograde or Mercury in retrograde conjunction, combine for the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus is retrograde or Mercury at retrograde conjunction, add the two for the motion difference.

sentences.zh: 如水星夕伏晨見者，直以太陽行分為行差。

translations.literal: As when Mercury is evening concealed and morning visible: use the sun's motion parts directly as the motion difference.
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury is evening concealed and morning visible, take the sun's motion parts directly as the motion difference.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星定合及見伏泛積】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation〉

sentences.zh: 木火土三星，各以平合晨疾夕伏定積，為定合定見定伏泛積。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, each uses the mean-conjunction morning-swift evening-concealed fixed accumulation as the fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, the mean-conjunction morning-swift evening-concealed fixed accumulation is the fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.

sentences.zh: 金水二星，置其段盈縮定差，

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, set that segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference,
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, set that segment's excess-and-deficit fixed difference,

sentences.zh: （水星倍之。）〉

translations.literal: (Double for Mercury.)
translations.idiomatic: (Double it for Mercury.)

sentences.zh: 各以行差除之，為日，不滿，退除為分秒；

translations.literal: Divide each by the motion difference for days; what does not fill, cast back for parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: divide each by the motion difference for days, and reduce any remainder to parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 若在平合夕見晨伏者，盈減縮加；

translations.literal: If at mean conjunction with evening visible and morning concealed: subtract in excess and add in deficit;
translations.idiomatic: at mean conjunction with evening visibility and morning concealment, subtract in excess and add in deficit;

sentences.zh: 如在退合夕伏晨見，盈加縮減；

translations.literal: If at retrograde conjunction with evening concealed and morning visible: add in excess and subtract in deficit;
translations.idiomatic: at retrograde conjunction with evening concealment and morning visibility, add in excess and subtract in deficit;

sentences.zh: 皆以加減定積為定合定見定伏泛積。

translations.literal: In every case add or subtract to the fixed accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the indicated additions and subtractions to the fixed accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, appearance, and concealment general accumulation.

sentences.zh: 〈【求五星定合定積定星】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find the five planets' fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find each planet's fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star〉

sentences.zh: 木火土三星，各以平合行差除其日太陽盈縮差，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, each divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the mean-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, divide each day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the mean-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day;

sentences.zh: 以太陽盈縮差減之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: Subtract it from the solar excess-and-deficit difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the solar excess-and-deficit difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree;

sentences.zh: 日在盈縮，以差日差度減之；

translations.literal: When the sun is in excess, subtract the difference day and difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: When the sun is in excess, subtract the difference day and difference degree;

sentences.zh: 在縮歷，加之；

translations.literal: When in the deficit cycle, add them;
translations.idiomatic: When in the deficit cycle, add them;

sentences.zh: 加減其星定合泛積，為定合定積定星。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to that star's fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract on that star's fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star.

sentences.zh: 金水二星，順合退合，各以平合退合行差，除其日太陽盈縮差，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in direct conjunction and retrograde conjunction, each divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the mean-conjunction or retrograde-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in direct or retrograde conjunction, divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the corresponding mean-conjunction motion difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference day;

sentences.zh: 順加退減太陽盈縮差，為距合差度；

translations.literal: In direct motion add and in retrograde subtract the solar excess-and-deficit difference to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: Add the solar excess-and-deficit difference in direct motion and subtract it in retrograde motion to obtain the conjunction-distance difference degree;

sentences.zh: 順在盈歷，以差日差度加之；

translations.literal: In direct motion when in the excess cycle, add the difference day and difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: In direct motion when in the excess cycle, add the difference day and difference degree;

sentences.zh: 在縮歷，減之；

translations.literal: When in the deficit cycle, subtract them;
translations.idiomatic: When in the deficit cycle, subtract them;

sentences.zh: 退在盈歷，以差日減之，差度加之；

translations.literal: In retrograde motion when in the excess cycle, subtract the difference day and add the difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: In retrograde motion when in the excess cycle, subtract the difference day and add the difference degree;

sentences.zh: 在縮歷，以差日加之，差度減之；

translations.literal: When in the deficit cycle, add the difference day and subtract the difference degree;
translations.idiomatic: When in the deficit cycle, add the difference day and subtract the difference degree;

sentences.zh: 皆以加減其定星定合再定合泛積，為定合再定合定積定星；

translations.literal: In every case add or subtract to that star's fixed star, fixed conjunction, and second fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, second fixed conjunction, fixed accumulation, and fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: Apply the indicated additions and subtractions to that star's fixed star, fixed conjunction, and second fixed-conjunction general accumulation to obtain the fixed conjunction, second fixed conjunction, fixed accumulation, and fixed star;

sentences.zh: 以冬至大余及約分加定積，滿紀法，去之，命得定合日辰；

translations.literal: Add the fixed accumulation to the winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts; when full, cast out the era rule; name accordingly — that yields the fixed conjunction day and double-hour;
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed accumulation to the winter solstice greater remainder and approximate parts, cast out full era rules, name the count, and obtain the fixed conjunction day and double-hour;

sentences.zh: 以冬至加時黃道日度加定星，滿宿次，去之，即得定合所在宿次。

translations.literal: Add the fixed star to the winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree; when full, cast out lodge sequences — that yields the lodge where the fixed conjunction stands.
translations.idiomatic: Add the fixed star to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at hour of addition, remove full lodge sequences, and obtain the lodge of the fixed conjunction.

sentences.zh: （其順退所在盈縮，即太陽盈縮。）〉

translations.literal: (Whether direct or retrograde, the excess or deficit applied is the solar excess and deficit.)
translations.idiomatic: (Whether the motion is direct or retrograde, the excess or deficit used is the sun's excess and deficit.)

sentences.zh: 〈【求木火土三星定見伏定日】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn's fixed appearance, concealment, and fixed day】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the fixed appearance, concealment, and fixed day for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn〉

sentences.zh: 各置其星定見伏泛積，晨加夕減象限日及分秒；

translations.literal: For each, set that star's fixed appearance-and-concealment general accumulation; at dawn add and at dusk subtract the image-limit day and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Set each star's fixed appearance-and-concealment general accumulation; at dawn add and at dusk subtract the image-limit day and parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: （半中限為象限。）〉

translations.literal: (Half the middle limit serves as the image limit.)
translations.idiomatic: (Half the middle limit serves as the image limit.)

sentences.zh: 如中限以下，自相乘；

translations.literal: If at or below the middle limit, square it;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below the middle limit, square it;

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減歲周日及分秒，余亦自相乘；

translations.literal: If above, overlay-subtract from the year circuit day and parts and seconds, and square the remainder likewise;
translations.idiomatic: If above, overlay-subtract from the year circuit day and parts and seconds and square the remainder likewise;

sentences.zh: 滿七十五而一，所得，以其星伏見度乘之，一十五除之，為差。

translations.literal: Divide by 75 for the obtained value; multiply by that star's heliacal appearance-and-concealment degree; divide by 15 for the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by 75, multiply by that star's heliacal appearance-and-concealment degree, and divide by 15 to obtain the difference.

sentences.zh: 其差，如其段行差而一，為日，不滿，退除為分秒；

translations.literal: Take the difference at one per that segment's motion difference for days; what does not fill, cast back for parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Divide the difference by that segment's motion difference for days; cast back the remainder into parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 見加伏減泛積，為定積；

translations.literal: At appearance add and at concealment subtract to the general accumulation for the fixed accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Add at appearance and subtract at concealment on the general accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulation;

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得日辰。

translations.literal: Add and name as before to obtain the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add and name as before to obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 〈【求金水二星定見伏定日】〉

translations.literal: 〈【To find Venus and Mercury's fixed appearance, concealment, and fixed day】〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈To find the fixed appearance, concealment, and fixed day for Venus and Mercury〉

sentences.zh: 各以伏見日行差，除其日太陽盈縮差，為日。

translations.literal: For each, divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the appearance-concealment daily motion difference to obtain days.
translations.idiomatic: For each star, divide that day's solar excess-and-deficit difference by the appearance-concealment daily motion difference to obtain days.

sentences.zh: 若晨伏夕見，日在盈歷，加之；

translations.literal: If morning concealment and evening appearance, when the sun is in the excess cycle add;
translations.idiomatic: For morning concealment and evening appearance, add when the sun is in the excess cycle;

sentences.zh: 在縮歷，減之；

translations.literal: When in the deficit cycle, subtract;
translations.idiomatic: when in the deficit cycle, subtract;

sentences.zh: 如夕伏晨見，日在盈縮，減之，在縮歷，加之；

translations.literal: If evening concealment and morning appearance, when the sun is in excess subtract, when in the deficit cycle add;
translations.idiomatic: For evening concealment and morning appearance, subtract when the sun is in excess and add when in the deficit cycle;

sentences.zh: 加減其星泛積，為常積。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to that star's general accumulation to obtain the regular accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract on that star's general accumulation to obtain the regular accumulation.

sentences.zh: 視常積，如中限以下，為冬至後；

translations.literal: View the regular accumulation: at or below the middle limit counts as after winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the regular accumulation: at or below the middle limit is after winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 以上，去之，余為夏至後。

translations.literal: If above, remove it and the remainder counts as after summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: above it, cast out the middle limit and take the remainder as after summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 其二至後，如象限以下，自相乘；

translations.literal: After each solstice, if at or below the image limit square it;
translations.idiomatic: After each solstice, square values at or below the image limit;

sentences.zh: 以上，覆減中限，余亦自相乘；

translations.literal: If above, overlay-subtract from the middle limit and square the remainder likewise;
translations.idiomatic: above it, overlay-subtract from the middle limit and square the remainder likewise;

sentences.zh: 各如法而一為分，

translations.literal: In each case divide by the appropriate divisor for parts,
translations.idiomatic: divide each by the appropriate divisor to obtain parts,

sentences.zh: （冬至後晨，夏至後夕，以一十八為法；

translations.literal: (After winter solstice at dawn and after summer solstice at dusk, use 18 as the divisor;
translations.idiomatic: (After winter solstice at dawn and after summer solstice at dusk, use 18 as the divisor;

sentences.zh: 冬至後夕，夏至後晨，以七十五為法。）〉

translations.literal: (After winter solstice at dusk and after summer solstice at dawn, use 75 as the divisor.)
translations.idiomatic: (after winter solstice at dusk and after summer solstice at dawn, use 75 as the divisor.)

sentences.zh: 以伏見度乘之，一十五除之，為差。

translations.literal: Multiply by the heliacal appearance-and-concealment degree and divide by 15 for the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the heliacal appearance-and-concealment degree and divide by 15 to obtain the difference.

sentences.zh: 其差，滿行差而一，為日，不滿，退除為分秒；

translations.literal: When the difference fills the motion difference, take one for days; what does not fill, cast back for parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: When the difference fills the motion difference, take one for days; cast back the remainder into parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 加減常積，為定積；

translations.literal: Add or subtract to the regular accumulation for the fixed accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract on the regular accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulation;

sentences.zh: （冬至後，晨見夕伏，加之；

translations.literal: (After winter solstice, morning appearance and evening concealment: add;
translations.idiomatic: (After winter solstice, for morning appearance and evening concealment, add;

sentences.zh: 夕見晨伏，減之。

translations.literal: Evening appearance and morning concealment: subtract.
translations.idiomatic: for evening appearance and morning concealment, subtract.

sentences.zh: 夏至後，晨見夕伏，減之；

translations.literal: After summer solstice, morning appearance and evening concealment: subtract;
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice, for morning appearance and evening concealment, subtract;

sentences.zh: 夕見晨伏，加之。）〉

translations.literal: (Evening appearance and morning concealment: add.)
translations.idiomatic: (for evening appearance and morning concealment, add.)

sentences.zh: 加命如前，即得定見伏日辰。

translations.literal: Add and name as before to obtain the fixed appearance-and-concealment day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add and name as before to obtain the fixed appearance-and-concealment day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 其水星，夕疾在大暑氣初日至立冬氣九日三十五分以下者，不見；

translations.literal: For Mercury, when in evening swift motion from the start of Great Heat qi through the ninth day 35 parts of Start of Winter qi, it is not visible;
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury in evening swift motion from the start of Great Heat through day 9, part 35 of Start of Winter, it is invisible;

sentences.zh: 晨留在大寒氣初日至立夏氣九日三十五分以下者，不見。

translations.literal: When in morning station from the start of Great Cold qi through the ninth day 35 parts of Start of Summer qi, it is not visible.
translations.idiomatic: When in morning station from the start of Great Cold through day 9, part 35 of Start of Summer, it is invisible.

sentences.zh: 春不晨見，秋不夕見者，亦舊歷有之。

translations.literal: In spring it is not seen at dawn and in autumn not at dusk—this too was known in old calendars.
translations.idiomatic: That it is not seen at dawn in spring or at dusk in autumn was also recorded in older calendars.
